$comment: The processes Dyno may start, for scripts/vm-smoke (docs: scripts/vm-smoke/README.md). Each process is Contents/MacOS/<name> of the installed bundle. parents: who may be its parent (app = the app process; launchd = parent pid 1, allowed only while Launch at login is on). argsPattern keeps the CLI calls of the check itself (dyno-agent status) out of the count. stateFiles name the discovery file the app finds its helper by: the pid in it must be the one live helper, and it is gone after Quit. ready: a command that exits 0 once the helper answers.

loginService.label: net.decryptology.dyno.agent
loginService.manualReason: the app registers its login item with SMAppService from the Aqua session; `dyno-agent service install` writes a legacy LaunchAgents plist and bootstraps it with launchctl, a different route that is not what users run, and tart exec has no Aqua session to run SMAppService in
loginService.approval: System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions may ask to allow the item (manual).

settleWhy: The app waits SPAWN_WAIT 5 s then CONNECT_GRACE 8 s (app/src-tauri/src/link.rs) before it spawns another agent; round 2 saw the duplicate 10 s after the first. 30 s covers two such rounds plus the 2 s polling.
